MATCH (p:Player) WHERE p.position IN ['Frontcourt', 'Backcourt'] RETURN p.position AS col1, MIN(CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64)) AS col2

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) WHERE p.position IS NOT NULL AND p.olympic_gold_medals IS NOT NULL WITH CASE WHEN LOWER(p.position) CONTAINS 'guard' OR LOWER(p.position) CONTAINS 'backcourt' THEN 'Backcourt' WHEN LOWER(p.position) CONTAINS 'forward' OR LOWER(p.position) CONTAINS 'center' OR LOWER(p.position) CONTAINS 'centre' OR LOWER(p.position) CONTAINS 'frontcourt' THEN 'Frontcourt' END AS position_group, CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS medals WHERE position_group IS NOT NULL RETURN position_group AS col1, MIN(medals) AS col2
